name: unifi-fabric
description: Runs the open-source UniFi Fabric MCP server locally (uvx, pinned release) with your own UniFi Site Manager API key, to read and manage UniFi sites, devices, clients, firewall, VPN and Protect cameras through Ubiquiti's cloud API (api.ui.com). Not affiliated with Ubiquiti Inc.

settings.name: UniFi Site Manager API key
settings.description: Your own UniFi Site Manager API key (unifi.ui.com > API Keys > Create New API Key; enable Site Manager and Network, add Protect for cameras). Stored in the system keychain; the server sends it only to api.ui.com.

settings.name: Write policy
settings.description: Enter allow (the default: read and write tools both work), dry-run (every write returns a preview and nothing is sent) or deny (refuse every write and action tool before anything is sent to UniFi). Enter allow to keep the default. Lower case; a blank or other value stops the server from starting.

settings.name: Tool mode
settings.description: discovery is the default; enter full to advertise every domain tool (recommended for gateways). Leave empty for discovery.
